hero.title: Kirima Rise.
hero.subtitle: Empowering Tomorrow.
hero.becomingBody: For years this place was known simply as Njiru Kirima land. A location on a map. A description of where something is, rather than what it is becoming. When the Estate set out to build a planned, serviced, properly titled community here, it began with the name.
hero.badgeDetail: Regularisation & inquiry now open for parcels in Block 220 (113 plots) and Block 179 (88 plots).

becoming.heading: What Kirima Rise Is Becoming
becoming.paragraph1: Kirima Rise is a planned community: surveyed, mapped, subdivided into individual plots, approved by county and national government, and moving steadily toward the issuance of individual titles.
becoming.paragraph2: It is roads and boundaries where there was open ground. It is addresses, where there were none. It is named courts and marked plots and most importantly, it is ownership.
becoming.paragraph3: In the founder's own spirit, that social and economic prosperity must exist in the same space, the land that once fed Nairobi will now anchor a secure, owned and thriving community.

updates.subtitle: Follow our on-the-ground progress, title deed issuances, and community engagements directly from the Estate of GK Kirima on YouTube.

updates.video1Desc: Kirima Rise has already begun giving out the first batch of title deeds to residents of Njiru who have completed the regularisation process. Learn more by reaching out through our official channels.
updates.video2Desc: We at Kirima Rise have made sure to engage local residents, financial institutions and local government to make the regularisation process as smooth and straightforward as possible.

heritage.title: Our Heritage & Legacy
heritage.subtitle: Rooted in decades of enterprise, integrity, and community building.
heritage.heroSubtitle: Rooted in decades of enterprise, integrity, and community building.
heritage.founderTitle: The Vision of Gerishon Kamau Kirima
heritage.founderStory: Gerishon Kamau Kirima arrived in Nairobi with vision, determination, and a deep-seated belief in hard work. From humble beginnings in the meat industry to becoming one of Kenya's most prominent real estate pioneers and public servants, his ethos was centered on progress and ownership. Today, under the leadership and stewardship of the Estate of G.K. Kirima, Kirima Rise honors this legacy by transforming the expansive Njiru land into a legally secure, well-planned residential and commercial neighborhood with guaranteed individual title deeds.

notice.title: Public Notice & Fraud Advisory
notice.subtitle: Protecting buyers, regularisation applicants, and the public from unauthorized agents and fraudulent accounts.
notice.warningBody: The Estate of G.K. Kirima wishes to warn all prospective plot owners and residents of Njiru that Kirima Rise operates ONLY through official legal bank accounts and authorized offices at Kirima House, Nairobi. No individual broker, agent, or field officer is authorized to accept cash or direct payments.
notice.channel1Desc: Kirima House, Mezzanine Floor, Mokhtar Daddah Street, Nairobi (Official lands verification & receipting counter).
notice.channel3Desc: Official payment details are issued only in-person at Kirima House or via verified official letters from our legal representatives.
notice.reportDesc: If someone solicits payment outside these channels or claims to represent the Estate of G.K. Kirima without official documentation, please report them to our security and legal desk immediately.
